title: [GMCP 203.005.02] Production path: Production-grade stdio transport
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-005-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: GMCP serves and consumes MCP over stdio with byte-accurate framing, bounded lines/messages, strict stdout protocol purity, stderr diagnostics, environment and working-directory control, graceful cancellation and shutdown, child-tree cleanup, backpressure, timeout handling, and Windows/Unix parity. Crash, hang, malformed output, descriptor leak, and hostile child fixtures all recover without stranding resources. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
